entities.name: Mini-ribonuclease 3-like protein (Q8RIL0)
observations: Exact sequence match to reviewed Fusobacterium nucleatum UniProt Q8RIL0; reference describes a possible role in RNA processing.
Sequence length 129 aa; estimated mass 15,027 Da and theoretical pI 8.81.
Pfam Ribonuclease_3 domain PF00636 detected at residues 17–111 (i-Evalue 2.5e-17).
Reference annotations include RNase III activity and RNA processing; related homologs support rRNA processing and cytoplasmic localization.
